definition_title: Shortened ambiguity subspaces and the continuous-uniform rate
natural_language_statement:
Let $C\subseteq F^I$ be a linear code on a finite coordinate set and let $E\subseteq I$. Its erasure ambiguity is the subspace in the original coordinates
$$C_E=\{c\in C:\operatorname{supp}(c)\subseteq E\}.$$
When coordinates are erased independently with probability $p$, the expected dimension is the finite sum over $E$ with weight $p^{|E|}(1-p)^{|I|-|E|}$. A doubly transitive code is preserved by a subgroup of coordinate permutations that sends any ordered pair of distinct coordinates to any other. The auxiliary code $B$ is the generalized Reed–Muller code of equation (5). Its proposed limiting rate is
$$\rho_d=\Pr\!\left[\sum_{j=1}^d X_j\le(d-3)/2\right],\qquad X_j\text{ independent uniform on }[0,1].$$
This provides the ambiguity notion required for varying-alphabet code families and for the rank test's auxiliary code.

**Formalization Note** A code is a Mathlib submodule. The probability defining $\rho_d$ is Lebesgue volume of the indicated measurable subset of $[0,1]^d$, whose total volume is one. In zero dimension the threshold is negative, so this set is empty. No Bochner integral or empty-set extremum is used. The finite erasure sum is evaluated only with $0\le p<1$ in theorems.
definition:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_ExpandingCodes_PolynomialStretch_PolynomialTest
set_option autoImplicit false
open scoped Classical

namespace ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch

open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable def ambiguity {F I : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype I]
    (C : Submodule F (I → F)) (E : Finset I) : Submodule F (I → F) where
  carrier := {v | v ∈ C ∧ ∀ i, i ∉ E → v i = 0}
  zero_mem' := ⟨C.zero_mem, by simp⟩
  add_mem' := by
    intro v w hv hw
    exact ⟨C.add_mem hv.1 hw.1, fun i hi => by simp [hv.2 i hi, hw.2 i hi]⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    intro a v hv
    exact ⟨C.smul_mem a hv.1, fun i hi => by simp [hv.2 i hi]⟩
noncomputable def erasureExpectation {F I : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype I]
    (C : Submodule F (I → F)) (p : ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ E : Finset I, p ^ E.card * (1 - p) ^ (Fintype.card I - E.card) *
    (Module.finrank F (ambiguity C E) : ℝ)
noncomputable def DoublyTransitiveCode {F : Type*} [Field F] (M : ℕ)
    (C : Submodule F (Fin M → F)) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin M)),
    (∀ σ ∈ H, ∀ c ∈ C, (fun i => c (σ i)) ∈ C) ∧
    ∀ a b a' b' : Fin M, a ≠ b → a' ≠ b' →
      ∃ σ ∈ H, σ a = a' ∧ σ b = b'
noncomputable def limitingRate (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (MeasureTheory.volume {x : Fin d → ℝ |
    (∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1) ∧ ∑ i, x i ≤ ((d : ℝ) - 3) / 2}).toReal
noncomputable def auxiliaryCode {d n : ℕ} (g : Geometry d n) :=
  reedMuller g.F d (auxiliaryDegree (Fintype.card g.F) d)

end ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch
source: Isaac M Hair, Amit Sahai, Expanding Codes with Polynomial Stretch, STOC 2027 submission #824 (October 2026), printed p. 10 / PDF p. 11, §2.2, erasure ambiguity, coordinate symmetries and Lemma 2.4 rate definition.
